title: I Hatched a Level 1 Slime. It Almost Ended the World.
summary: A boy hatches a friendly slime that doubles every time someone hits it. The whole kingdom has to apologize to bring it home.
frame_0: Tiny smiles over a blue-sky kingdom with its castle, king and dragon floating inside him. The boy in red holds the broken shell under the two-line title.
package_differences: Jake approved the enlarged two-sentence cover and the wolf-height first doubling. Tiny’s planted upper-body wobble slows as he grows, with the eyes and smile following a beat late.
camera: steady opening cuts, gliding interior, locked scale comparisons
